content.title: Style carousel variations｜Same outfit across poster layouts
content.summary: The same high-position characters and clothing are continuously locked, and the background gradually switches from solid-color portraits to black and white fonts, newspaper collages, and color clippings; the characters only make small changes in posture, and each round uses a higher format density to verify the identity without losing it. As a short-duration evidence variant of the same identity-locked style world carousel, no new selector is added.

quick_start.input_format: Fixed subject identity and lens relationship + at least four style worlds with different materials/formats + changing two style channels at each stage + increasing density + readable identity final state
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original parchment warehouse, a brass clockwork courier establishes his identity with an oval panel, a crescent badge and a folding tool belt; the same courier enters the pink plant console, the route ring is replaced by two transparent seed meters, the forearms become pink armor, and the face, body shape and badge remain unchanged; the environment is condensed into a restrained purple acoustic cabin, the courier wears a small listening disk and a purple collar patch, redundant charts are removed, and the oval face plate, crescent badge and posture are completely retained
required_anchors: Establish one stable identity, lens relation and recurring accessory against a low-density opening world.
Change the surrounding style world while keeping face, silhouette and camera axis stable.
Use at least one additional world with different layout logic rather than a palette swap alone.
Return to a readable portrait-scale terminal state with the original identity anchors intact.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: The same high-position characters and clothing are continuously locked, and the background gradually switches from solid-color portraits to black and white fonts, newspaper collages, and color clippings; the characters only make small changes in posture, and each round uses a higher format density to verify the identity without losing it. As a short-duration evidence variant of the same identity-locked style world carousel, no new selector is added.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Lock one subject identity, lens position and performance scale before cycling through several materially different style worlds. Change at least two coordinated channels per phase—such as backdrop system, palette, graphic density, props or wardrobe accents—while preserving face, silhouette and one recurring accessory. Escalate world density, then return to a readable portrait-scale terminal state that proves identity survived the carousel.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable identity, lens relation and recurring accessory against a low-density opening world.
invariants.purpose: Creates a comparison baseline for later style changes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Beginning with maximal clutter hides identity continuity.

invariants.rule: Change the surrounding style world while keeping face, silhouette and camera axis stable.
invariants.purpose: Proves environment can vary independently of the subject.
invariants.ablation_failure: Simultaneous identity and camera replacement prevents comparison.

invariants.rule: Escalate to a wider or denser stage while retaining the same subject anchors.
invariants.purpose: Tests continuity under increased layout pressure.
invariants.ablation_failure: Only recoloring a flat background is too weak to prove the carousel.

invariants.rule: Use at least one additional world with different layout logic rather than a palette swap alone.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated near-identical posters become a slideshow of skins.

invariants.rule: Return to a readable portrait-scale terminal state with the original identity anchors intact.
invariants.purpose: Closes the style cycle on an auditable subject proof.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on a background or anonymous silhouette loses the identity contract.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source dark-haired fashion woman and brown fur-trimmed outfit
the source MUSIC GIRL wall and magazine/newspaper layouts
the source pink-blue IDOL collage and pseudo-headlines

instantiations.concept: An original clockwork courier stands beneath a fixed overhead lens with one crescent chest badge. A quiet parchment depot changes into a cobalt navigation chamber, a pink horticulture console, a green repair atlas and an amber listening booth; tools and armor accents change with each duty while the same faceplate, body proportions and badge remain locked, ending on a calm violet portrait.

instantiations.concept: A felt deep-sea archivist remains under one high circular lens while its room cycles from blank canvas to woven tide map, brass specimen grid, translucent current diagram and dense indigo label wall. Each stage changes material and layout logic, but the same stitched face, shell clasp and hand rhythm persist before a final low-density portrait return.
